cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we go on for the skating qualifier, name the outcome we haven't prepared for. We need a complete plan, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to put failure in your head.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's already there. Saying 'failure' isn't specific enough. Finish this: 'We might not...'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Keep that promise. Now say what you think I'm afraid you'd do if we didn't qualify. Please don't make me supply both sides of this discussion.

reason: Make A instruct the naming exercise while B's continued-partnership reassurance opens the next vulnerable fear; avoid detached analysis of the second sentence.
